title: SGD Selects Initialization-Dependent Representation in Overparameterized ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Overparameterized neural networks can represent the same function through many different hidden configurations, raising the question of which representation is favored by a given training algorithm. We study how stochastic gradient descent (SGD), jointly training both layers, resolves this ambiguity in finite-width, bias-free, two-layer ReLU networks trained to learn a linear teacher under Gaussian inputs. At width two, exact fitting leaves no choice: the neurons must align with the teacher directions. At every width $m \ge 4$, however, infinitely many non-aligned exact fits are possible. Despite this ambiguity, we prove that joint batch-size-one SGD from sufficiently small initialization drives every neuron arbitrarily close to one of the two teacher directions while reaching arbitrarily small population error in finite time. This occurs without explicit regularization, layerwise training, gradient clipping, or a learning-rate schedule.

translated_title: SGD在过参数化ReLU网络中选择依赖于初始化的表示
translated_abstract: 过参数化神经网络可以通过许多不同的隐藏层配置来表示同一个函数，这引发了一个问题：给定的训练算法会偏向于哪种表示。我们研究了随机梯度下降（SGD）在同时训练两层的情况下，如何在有限宽度、无偏置的两层ReLU网络（在训练中于高斯输入下学习线性教师函数）中解决这种歧义。当宽度为二时，精确拟合没有选择的余地：神经元必须与教师方向对齐。然而，在每个宽度 m ≥ 4 时，都可能存在无穷多个未与教师对齐的精确拟合。尽管存在这种歧义，我们证明了从足够小的初始化出发的批量大小为一的联合SGD，能在有限时间内使每个神经元任意接近两个教师方向之一，同时达到任意小的总体误差。这一结果无需显式正则化、逐层训练、梯度裁剪或学习率调度即可实现。
tldr: 本文证明，在过参数化的两层ReLU网络中，尽管存在无穷多个非对齐的精确拟合解，从小初始化出发的SGD无需任何显式正则化或特殊训练技巧，即可在有限时间内使所有神经元对齐教师方向并达到任意小的误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in overparameterized two-layer ReLU networks, despite infinitely many non-aligned exact fits, joint SGD from sufficiently small initialization aligns every neuron with teacher directions and achieves arbitrarily small error in finite time, without explicit regularization, layerwise training, gradient clipping, or learning-rate schedules.
